criteria.text: `src/scoring.ts` exists, imports only from `./sql.js`, and exports exactly `pmiRank`, `sortKey`, `signatureFloor`, `isName` — no `namePhrase` export exists anywhere in the codebase, and each export is built only through `src/sql.ts`'s `sql` tag.

`src/graph.ts` contains no local `sortKey` declaration and no `namePhrase` function; neither `src/graph.ts` nor `src/aggregate.ts` contains the literal substrings `pmi * ln(1 + ` or `greatest(3,` outside a comment (they now live once, inside `src/scoring.ts`).

`graphQuery` and `graphFastQuery` order and select their `nodes_top` sort column via `sortKey(q.sort, ...)`; `compareSideCte`'s `top_pmi` orders via `pmiRank(...)` alone, never via `sortKey`; `personTermsQuery`'s per-`min` ranks order via `pmiRank(...)`.

Every own-name filter that today calls `namePhrase` (`graphQuery`, `risingQuery`, `weekQuery`, both sides of `compareSideCte`) and `aggregate.ts`'s hand-written predicate all call `isName` instead; `compareQuery`'s existing `isName(sql.raw('k.term'), ...)` call keeps the same shape, now importing the function from `scoring.ts`.

`test/graph.test.ts`'s `statements render the same text the routes run` describe block, its `shared graph aggregations (issue #45)` describe block (the `splitCases` sweep against hand-written reference SQL run independently of `graph.ts`), and its own-name/phrase test at `:2601-2624` all pass unmodified.

`test/aggregate.test.ts`'s fast/live cross-product sweep (every entry of `recortes` × every fixture person) and its `the ceiling on graph_terms` describe block pass unmodified — this is what proves `personTermsQuery`'s rewritten own-name predicate still produces row-identical output to the live query, since nothing pins that predicate's exact text.

A new `test/scoring.test.ts`, with no database, asserts: `pmiRank` renders `pmi * ln(1 + <count>)` and binds nothing of its own; `sortKey('pmi', ...)` renders `pmiRank`'s expression inside the `case`'s `then` branch and binds `sort` once; `signatureFloor` renders `greatest(3, <about> * 0.05)`; `isName` ORs the bare-word check and the phrase check and binds `names` twice (once per occurrence in the text, per `src/sql.ts`'s rule); an array of these fragments composes correctly through `sql.join` (placeholders stay numbered in order), matching how `personTermsQuery` builds one `ranks` entry per `MINS` value.

CLAUDE.md's description of `src/aggregate.ts` names `src/scoring.ts` as the one place the pmi ordering, the signature floor and the own-name filter live, rather than only cross-referencing `graphQuery` and `aggregate.ts` against each other.

`docsText` (every page in `README.md`+`docs/*.md` concatenated, per `test/docs.ts`) states that the pmi-ordering and signature-floor formulas live in `src/scoring.ts` — the fact, not any particular heading or file split.

`test/docs-drift.test.ts` does not apply here: it covers the collector registry against `docs/sources.md`, unrelated to this issue's SQL fragments, so no new criterion duplicates it.
